messages:
mina: Quick check — finalizing the production handoff playbook for next Tue rollout. Need alignment on SLA targets, runbooks, monitoring/alerts, docs freeze, and pricing page language. Propose: 99.95% uptime, p95 latency goal 150ms for text-gen (dedicated), error budget 0.05%. Who owns final docs, runbooks, and pricing copy? Please call blockers and owners.

aj: SLA numbers look reasonable for Dedicated. For Hosted we should be explicit: p95 target 200–250ms depending on region and multi-tenant load. I recommend an SLO matrix: Hosted / Dedicated / Private with separate latency/error targets. I’ll own SLO matrix and add it to the repo. ETA: EOD Fri.

sofia: Monitoring notes: we need synthetic e2e checks per-region every 1m and a canary job per-release. Alerting rules: p95 > target for 5m -> page, error_rate > 0.5% for 10m -> page. Also create a derived metric for error-budget burn rate. I’ll draft runbooks for paging actions and fallback flows.

carl: Docs status: API changelog is done. Migration guide is 60% (streaming & function-calls examples missing). Need SDK freeze by Thu otherwise docs/examples will diverge. I can draft the user-facing runbook summary and FAQ if engineering confirms no surface changes. Owner: carl.

lee: Support readiness: need Zendesk playbook with triage categories: latency, incorrect output, billing, quota. Also require a short internal FAQ + postmortem template + escalation matrix. Who’s primary pager week1? We should have a 24/7 rotation for first two weeks.

mina: I’ll cover escalation week1 to keep context tight. @lee please set up rotation and training session Fri AM. No API surface changes planned — aj confirm.

aj: Confirmed: no breaking API changes. One beta-only param rename — will not block GA. SDK freeze OK.

sofia: Proposed alert rule (PromQL-ish) — will add to monitoring repo:
```
alert: InferenceHighP95
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(inference_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, model, region)) > TARGET_P95
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: page
annotations:
  summary: "Inference p95 > target for {{ $labels.model }} in {{ $labels.region }}"
```
Also: canary policy: 100 qps for 30m against baseline. If error-budget burn > 2x baseline OR p95 > target for 10m -> automatic rollback to previous deployment and page oncall. I will PR runbook + alert rules by Fri.

carl: Docs checklist I need from eng/SRE:
- Final SLO matrix (latency/uptime per deployment)
- Canary policy text + example logs
- Runbook summary for support (short, copyable FAQ)
- SDK snippets (py/js) for streaming and function call
If those are provided by Fri noon I can ship docs.

lee: Support items I need:
- Escalation matrix (names + phone) — mina to confirm week1 owner (ack).
- Quick triage script for latency vs model errors (what to check first: region, model variant, KV cache status).
- Billing/pricing FAQ: mapping between hosted-per-token and reserved capacity discounts.

mina: Pricing/prod notes: base hosted pricing stays per-token. We will publish Dedicated reserved tiers with 3-month and 12-month commitments and a clear uplift for premium SLAs. Need final blurb for Pricing page: who drafts? @product-marketing? For now, I’ll draft the technical appendix (limits, quotas, example math) and hand to marketing.

aj: Engineering checklist before handoff:
- Confirm no breaking API changes (done)
- Freeze SDKs (Thu)
- Smoke tests pass in canary region (sofia)
- Automated rollback and fallback variants enabled (sofia + aj)
I’ll open a PR with the freeze commit.

sofia: Runbook ownership: I'll own the primary incidents runbook + canary automation. aj owns rollback automation and model-variant fallback. carl owns the public runbook summary. lee owns support playbook + Zendesk categories. Mina will be week1 escalation.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout window: 2025-06-10 03:00 UTC. Canary start will emit first metrics at 03:05 UTC.

mina: Action items recap (please ack):
- aj: SLO matrix + SDK freeze (ETA Thu EOD)  -> owner: aj
- sofia: Monitoring rules + runbooks + canary automation (ETA Fri) -> owner: sofia
- carl: Docs: migration guide + FAQ + examples (ETA Fri noon) -> owner: carl
- lee: Support rotation + Zendesk playbook (ETA Fri) -> owner: lee
- mina: Pricing appendix draft + week1 escalation -> owner: mina
If no objections I’ll mark this as the handoff playbook and start the shiproom checklist tomorrow. React with :thumbsup: when you’ve got it.

aj: :thumbsup:
sofia: :thumbsup:
carl: :thumbsup:
lee: :thumbsup:

mina: Thanks everyone — I’ll consolidate PR links and send the shiproom invite.
